slides.purpose: inserted summary of the VeriSMo-inspired C-kernel verification plan

layout_rationale.layout_pattern: six-step serpentine route plus four-part synthesis
layout_rationale.why_fit: The source material is organized as six connected verification units that converge into four responsibilities and one combined TEE-security conclusion; the existing slide-5 geometry expresses this logic without introducing a new visual language.
layout_rationale.risk: The reused source slide is an ending-style page, so wording is kept compact and the footer is marked 4A to avoid changing the original slide-5 number.

slides.notes: 这一页把借鉴 VeriSMo 后的 C 内核验证路线压缩为两层组合。Rocq 机器模型直接描述地址翻译、RMP、寄存器和恶意 Hypervisor 的环境步骤，并证明私有页机密性、完整性与地址稳定；C 实现侧通过 CompCert Clight 和 VST 显式重建页面、页表、锁与寄存器的资源权限。硬件原语契约把两层连接起来，再叠加接口精化、安全标签和顶层 unwinding，形成对 TEE 内核的组合安全结论。与 Rust 方案相比，C 版本的指针别名、未定义行为和汇编包装器会增加证明负担与可信基，因此首个案例应聚焦页面私有与共享切换。
